name: Copper Modulator
label: Quest
description: Copper Modulator: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yebb is developing a new attraction for the Zoo Bizarre, one that will drive people crazy with wonder, and delight! But it will take a lot of work, and a lot of materials...
That includes copper modulators. We need lots of modulators for the mechanical parts of the attraction. Bring me copper modulators and I'll trade for them with a Darkmoon Faire ticket.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can't tell you exactly what we're building, but these will be invaluable for its construction. I am in your debt, friend, but please, take this Darkmoon Faire ticket as a token of my appreciation.
